purpose: Calculates p_ncs, the probability of non-cross-slip (twin nucleus formation), which is used together with p_st to obtain the total number density of twin nuclei per unit time.
applicability_conditions: Fe-22wt.% Mn-0.6wt.% C model TWIP steel; one coherent parameter set used over the whole temperature range (seven different temperatures).

symbols.meaning: probability of non-cross-slip / twin nucleus formation
averaged resolved shear stress (combined from cell interior and cell wall resolved shear stresses via a mixing law)

unmapped: The total number density of twin nuclei per unit time is theta_dot = p_st * p_ncs (Eq. 25).
tau_rss is used later in Eqs. 24 and 26 to calculate the probability of twin nucleation.
tau_r (subscript r) is not explicitly defined in the provided excerpt.
